track.title: Paired Horizon
track.purpose: Keep a bass identity while its upper range changes stereo position.
track.hypothesis: A stable low anchor can support clear upper-bass motion without a new pitch sequence.
track.invariant: The bass phrase and central low-frequency anchor remain unchanged during the first return.
